backlog.title: A Scorpio partner watches consistency, not reassurance
backlog.hook: Partner: Why isn't saying “trust me” enough? Scorpio: Because I remember what you promised — and I watch what you do next.
backlog.angle: Two-person dialogue: separate complete trust from jealousy by showing a promise-and-follow-through scene; consistency is framed as a preference, not a universal law.
backlog.why_now: Evergreen Route A/C candidate grounded in two directly readable cross-platform sources: an X girlfriend-role post with 8.2K visible views and a YouTube role description with 1.7K views. It tests a concrete relationship behavior without diagnosing or predicting.

backlog.title: A Scorpio spouse may keep the argument off the group chat
backlog.hook: Friend: Send me the screenshots. Scorpio spouse: No — private doesn't mean dishonest, but this fight belongs in the relationship first.
backlog.angle: Two-person dialogue: a friend asks for conflict screenshots and the spouse explains privacy; explicitly distinguish healthy privacy from isolation or concealment.
backlog.why_now: Evergreen Route A/C candidate based on a directly readable X marriage-privacy post with 4.8K visible views, 41 likes, 8 reposts and 54 bookmarks. It converts an abstract secrecy stereotype into a recognizable group-chat conflict.

backlog.title: What a Scorpio may want after marriage: peace, not power
backlog.hook: Partner: I thought you wanted intensity. Scorpio spouse: I did — now I want a home where neither of us has to stay on guard.
backlog.angle: Two-person dialogue: contrast early relationship intensity with the desire for an emotionally safe home; keep the claim conditional because the source is an Ascendant-specific small sample.
backlog.why_now: Evergreen Route A/C test from a directly readable Scorpio Ascendant marriage post with 1.8K visible views. Evidence strength is weak, so this is a lower-priority small-sample candidate rather than a broad Scorpio claim.

backlog.title: A Scorpio mom notices the one detail that changed
backlog.hook: Kid: I finished my homework. Scorpio mom: Then why is your backpack still zipped?
backlog.angle: Two-person parent-child dialogue: use one observable contradiction to show an honesty standard, then balance it by saying children need room to admit mistakes safely.
backlog.why_now: Evergreen Route A/C candidate supported by an X Scorpio-mother joke with 8.6K visible views and readable replies plus a YouTube role description. Mother-role evidence is the strongest family-role signal in this sample; no equivalent father candidate is generated.

backlog.title: Dating a Scorpio: intensity still needs boundaries
backlog.hook: Partner: We talked until 2 a.m., then you disappeared all day. Scorpio: I needed space — but you still deserved a clear message.
backlog.angle: Two-person dating dialogue: validate the need to decompress after closeness while refusing to romanticize hot-and-cold behavior; give a communication boundary rather than a diagnosis.
backlog.why_now: Evergreen Route A/C candidate grounded in a directly readable Quora first-person two-year relationship account describing high highs and low lows. Engagement is not verifiable, so the score reflects lived-detail value rather than claimed heat.
